title: Lamentations Bible Quiz - Chapter 2
description: Ten questions on Lamentations 2: the anger that covered the daughter of Zion, the silent elders, the hungry children and the mocking passers-by.

questions.text: What has the Lord done to the daughter of Zion in his anger?
questions.explanation: The chapter opens by asking how the Lord has covered the daughter of Zion with a cloud in his anger.

answers.text: He has crowned her with glory
He has hidden her in the wilderness
He has covered her with a cloud
He has washed her with water

questions.text: What has he cast down from heaven to the earth?
questions.explanation: He has cast the beauty of Israel down from heaven to the earth, and has not remembered his footstool in the day of his anger.

answers.text: The beauty of Israel
The throne of David
The ark of the covenant
The stars of the sky

questions.text: What has he bent like an enemy?
questions.explanation: He has bent his bow like an enemy and has stood with his right hand as an adversary.

answers.text: His staff
His sword
The wall of the city
His bow

questions.text: What has Yahweh caused to be forgotten in Zion?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has caused solemn assembly and Sabbath to be forgotten in Zion, and has despised the king and the priest.

answers.text: The law and the prophets
Solemn assembly and Sabbath
The name of the king
The songs of the temple

questions.text: What does verse 9 say about her prophets?
questions.explanation: Her king and her princes are among the nations where the law is not, and her prophets find no vision from Yahweh.

answers.text: They have fled to Egypt
They prophesy day and night
They find no vision from Yahweh
They have gathered the people to pray

questions.text: What do the elders of the daughter of Zion do?
questions.explanation: The elders sit on the ground and keep silence; they have cast dust on their heads and clothed themselves with sackcloth.

answers.text: They sit on the ground in silence, with dust on their heads
They stand in the gate and judge the people
They sing at the altar in the temple
They gather the people together for war

questions.text: What do the children ask their mothers as they swoon in the streets?
questions.explanation: They ask their mothers, Where is grain and wine? as they swoon like the wounded in the streets of the city.

answers.text: Where is the king?
Where is grain and wine?
Where is Yahweh?
Where is the enemy?

questions.text: What did men once call the city, according to those who pass by and mock her?
questions.explanation: All who pass by clap their hands, hiss and wag their head, saying: Is this the city that men called The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth?

answers.text: The city of the great king of Judah
The holy place of the God of Israel
The strong tower of the nations
The perfection of beauty, the joy of the whole earth

questions.text: What does verse 17 say Yahweh has done?
questions.explanation: Yahweh has done that which he planned and has fulfilled his word that he commanded in the days of old; he has thrown down and has not pitied.

answers.text: He has forgotten the word he spoke
He has turned back his anger from her
He has done what he planned and fulfilled his word
He has pitied the daughter of Zion

questions.text: What is called for in the night, at the beginning of the watches?
questions.explanation: The wall of the daughter of Zion is told to let tears run down, to arise and cry out in the night, and to pour out her heart like water before the face of the Lord.

answers.text: To arise and cry out, pouring out the heart like water
To keep silent until the morning comes
To shut the gates and sleep until dawn
To sing for joy before the face of the Lord
